$comment: CockroachDB Cloud Managed MCP Server — one of the two CockroachDB tools this project uses.
It gives an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code) direct, read-only, audited access to
the live memory cluster. We use it during development to inspect what the agent actually stored,
verify the vector index is being used by EXPLAIN, and check recall latency against real data —
without writing a throwaway admin script or exposing a write path.
Read-only is deliberate: the agent inspects production memory but cannot mutate it, so a bad
generated query can't corrupt the store. Every call is logged in the CockroachDB Cloud audit log.
COCKROACH_MCP_API_KEY comes from the MCP Server panel in the CockroachDB Cloud Console.
